en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding
a man who broke a hand of a man, then the hand of the man was cured. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no retaliation regarding this, but he would be given the compensation’.
